description: Renders one page (slide, layout or master) as a PNG. Without output_path it returns contentUrl + width/height — the URL is short-lived (~30 minutes) and served from googleusercontent.com. With output_path the PNG is downloaded and saved to that local file instead (the download is restricted to Google's image hosts). size: large (1600px, default), medium (800px) or small (200px). This is the way to SEE what a slide actually looks like — the JSON never shows rendering. Counts as an expensive read in the API quota.

output_path.description: Local file path to save the PNG to; omitted = return the short-lived contentUrl.

page_object_id.description: The slide's object id to render (from list_slides).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: get_thumbnail
title: Get a slide thumbnail
